details:
Groups is an accurate, but lousy name, btw. Guilds is clearly a more fun word. 

But anyway, give us "Group home worlds". The one thing that has always held and will hold vrchat back, is that the way its designed, it can't support a large amount (1000+) players in a single world. It's not a true mmo where people can explore and meets others and fully have a good time without increasing the absolute scale of the game. There's a reason everything is called a "room". 

While that's a super hard issue to fix, with problems on every single side, from CPU to optimization to quality of everything to even world size practicality limits, this could be the first step. 

Finally, you could have a permeant instance where it's just always open for people to join, even if the player count is currently 0/40. Optional ability to spawn in there and feel like youre truly apart of the group, instantly surrounded by others. Even self-made worlds would not feel as good and instantly appealing as a permeant group home instance. Sadly, if the group rises significantly above 80, this might become an issue, requiring temporary split off instances of the same world. But even in a group of 250, it'd be rare for 80 players to be online and all in the world at the same time. The majority of groups won't have this issue though. 

It's the first small, tiny step in advancing forward past the limits and bringing vrchat to another level.
title: Give us Guild Halls
